resources.string: Automatically matches the L7 display area. The panel is approximately %1$d×%2$d mm, calculated from the 13.2-inch specification. The floating sidebar does not change the projection size.
The head unit assigns speakers by usage: music 1, navigation 12, calls 2 and Siri 16. These are usage values, not device IDs. Changes apply on the next connection.

Standard usage lets the head unit assign the output. Factory usage and legacy streams are advanced compatibility options. Legacy streams 1–20 are not usage values, device IDs or speaker positions. Preview does not save; saved changes apply on the next connection.
Previewing does not save settings. Make sure vehicle audio is audible and operate only while parked.
Preview stopped. Settings have not been saved.
Test tone sent. Check whether you heard it.\nActual output: %1$s.\nVerify the result in the vehicle.

Decoder initialization failed, or no video output was confirmed after receiving data. Diagnostic logs include configuration, decoding and rendering details. Turn off HEVC, switch to H.264 and reconnect. Hotspot settings will remain unchanged.
Call echo cancellation and noise suppression
Use supported system effects during calls. Turn off if echo, volume or routing becomes worse. Applies on the next connection.

Off by default: playback and recording use system routing, matching the upstream audio path. Enable only after confirming vehicle support. Missing or rejected devices fall back to the system. Applies on the next connection.

Restore music usage 1, navigation usage 12 and Siri usage 16; calls use usage 2. Enable audio focus and advanced mapping, disable extra BUS routing, and restore default buffering and call effects. Pairing, authentication and Bluetooth handoff settings stay unchanged. Applies on the next connection.

L7 headrest check: enable the vehicle’s driver audio mode and check navigation, Siri and calls separately. Music ducking follows Boyue focus behavior. Turning audio focus off affects all audio; the head unit may still apply its own mixing policy.
Uses system communication usage. Verify headrest output during a real call.
